devenv(1)                   General Commands Manual                   devenv(1)

NAME
     devenv - Fast, Declarative, Reproducible, and Composable Developer Environments

SYNOPSIS
     devenv [--no-tui] [-h|--help] [-V|--version] <subcommands>

DESCRIPTION
     Fast, Declarative, Reproducible, and Composable Developer Environments

OPTIONS
     --user-config <USER_CONFIG>
            Use this user configuration file instead of the XDG default

     -V, --version
            Print version

     -h, --help
            Print help (see a summary with '-h')

INPUT OVERRIDES
     -o, --override-input <NAME> <URI>
            Override inputs in devenv.yaml.

     -O, --option <OPTION:TYPE> <VALUE>
            Override configuration options with typed values.

SUBCOMMANDS
     devenv-init(1)
            Scaffold devenv.yaml, devenv.nix, and .gitignore.

     devenv-shell(1)
            Activate the developer environment.

     devenv-up(1)
            Start processes.

     devenv-processes(1)
            Start or stop processes.

     devenv-processes-up(1)
            Start the processes defined in devenv.nix.

     devenv-processes-down(1)
            Stop the processes defined in devenv.nix.

     devenv-version(1)
            Print the version of devenv.
